dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...These are all just everyday items, no?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: *low voice* You got that right! I sell everyday items. What else would I be selling?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Haven't you heard the saying, "silence is golden"? Well, if silence is golden, quietness has to be silver at least?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: *whispering* So when you're doing business, you've got to talk in whispers so the Mora keeps rolling in!

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: *whispering* But you youngsters wouldn't understand, you're easily led astray by wacky ideas...
